C1557.title: Delegated Keys for Smart Wallets: Enabling Secure Transaction Execution from Apple Watch via ERC-4337 and Kernel Wallet
C1557.summary: This research examines the security of executing transactions from an Apple Watch using ERC-4337 and Kernel Wallet. It highlights that when a server submits ERC-4337 UserOperations to a Bundler without per-transaction biometric verification, an attacker who gains access to the smartwatch could submit malicious UserOperations.
